_comment: Local curated quirks for DLSS5oneclick Install. Matched by exe stem (case-insensitive) or path substring. Applied into dlss5-feed.cfg after quality seed. No cloud. early_color is off by default unless seeded.

overrides.note: DX9 via dgVoodoo; estimated MV / OFA — engine velocity off (no useful RT). early_color N/A. Weak CPU: try async_feed=1 (display lag ~1 frame, not FPS delay).
overrides.setup_tip: Gothic on a weak CPU: enable async_feed=1 in Feeder (F10 in-game, or Setup) — hides NR wait behind ~1 frame of input/display lag. Not an FPS delay.

overrides.note: UE3 LE — velocity hunt often latches wrong RGBA; engine_velocity OFF, prefer OFA/estimated MV + LightStab.
No useful velocity RT — engine_velocity off; 75% work, OFA MEDIUM. early_color N/A.
RE Engine — needs REFramework; DX12 often; early_color N/A (Phase 2).
REDengine DX11 Feeder candidate — early_color seed ON (experimental; overlay to verify cand). Off if Present looks better.
UE Shipping without native DLSS — Feeder Present path. Disable TAA in-game to reduce double temporal. early_color N/A on DX12 v1.
overrides.setup_tip: Unreal tip: turn TAA/TSR off in the game's graphics options (or set r.AntiAliasingMethod=0 yourself). This tool does not edit Engine.ini.

overrides.note: Native DLSS — use Opti / RenoDX / Upstream. Do not Force Feeder unless you explicitly want the Present path.
